query: "Studies on anomaly detection techniques for error identification in corpora, focusing on modeling probability distributions over annotated data like Penn Treebank, to automatically flag annotation errors in POS tagging using statistical methods and their applications in corpus quality assurance."

response.query: Studies on anomaly detection techniques for error identification in corpora, focusing on modeling probability distributions over annotated data like Penn Treebank, to automatically flag annotation errors in POS tagging using statistical methods and their applications in corpus quality assurance.
response.answer: Anomaly detection techniques model probability distributions to identify POS tagging errors in corpora, enhancing corpus quality assurance. Statistical methods like changepoint models and ARIMA are used for this purpose. These techniques aim to improve the accuracy of annotated data with minimal human intervention.

results.title: [PDF] POS error detection in automatically annotated corpora
results.content: POS error detection in automatically annotated corpora Ines Rehbein SFB 632 Information Structure German Department Potsdam University irehbein@uni-potsdam.de Abstract Recent work on error detection has shown that the quality of manually annotated corpora can be substantially improved by applying consistency checks to the data and automatically identi-fying incorrectly labelled instances. 2 Related Work Most work on (semi-)automatic POS error detection has focussed on identifying errors in POS assigned by human annotators where variation in word-POS assignments in the corpus can be caused either by ambiguous word forms which, depending on the context, can belong to different word classes, or by incorrect judgments made by the annotators (Eskin, 2000; van Halteren, 2000; Kvˇ etoˇ n and Oliva, 2002; Dickinson and Meurers, 2003; Loftsson, 2009). Figure 1: Trade-off between precision and recall for different marginal probability thresholds 26 6 Conclusions In the paper, we presented and evaluated a system for automatic error detection in POS tagged corpora, with the goal of increasing the quality of so-called silver standards with minimal human effort.
